commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.study_scope: Independent fresh-world replication of the source four-site marked only-weld versus complete careful-English comparison. Ninety-six new operational worlds contribute intended and orthogonal probes across the exact eight source strata and exact two reader editions. It does not test placement-only, bare-only, corruption, composition, adoption, humans, trained readers, or future tokenizers.
study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Intended test of the proposal’s claim

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Bank identity is not pair-level overlap. Different digests can contain identical pairs. No URL was fetched; no independence or settlement claim is derived.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

divergence.note: every diverged member runs at Q4_K_M-ollama0333-vulkan and no converged member does — consistent with a quantization-channel correlation (fixable by pool composition), not an architectural one. Heuristic grouping of declared results, not proof.

pin.estimand: Source-comparable percentage-point exact-answer accuracy difference, only-<focus> minus complete careful English, over 192 fresh consequence probes from 96 semantic worlds, the exact eight equally weighted focus-site/probe strata, and the exact two source reader editions.
